name: Dr. Gorav Gupta
designation: CEO, Senior Consultant Psychiatrist with over 20 Years of Experience
bioHtml:
Dr. Gorav Gupta, Senior Consultant Psychiatrist of the Indian Continent, practices in Delhi NCR. He completed his MBBS from the prestigious institute, Maulana Azad Medical College (Delhi University) and M.D. from Lady Hardinge Medical College (Delhi University) in 1997. He is renowned for pioneering super specialized work in psycho-social rehabilitation in psychiatry.

National recognition was accorded for his deep commitment and dedication in developing infrastructure for mentally sick patients by appointing him as President of Mental Research Society.

Dr. Gupta runs a 100 bed psychiatry and de-addiction center known as Tulasi Psychiatry and Rehabilitation Centre, a 50 bed halfway home known as Tulasi Home for patients with chronic mental illness and a psychiatric center which are all in South Delhi. The organization is successfully running for more than 15 years and is well known for treatment modules adopted to treat addiction.

Another 125-bed Psychiatry and Rehabilitation center in Gurgaon has been operational since 2019.

Dr Gupta worked as an advisor to Government of India for framing the rules and regulations for Mental Health care Act 2017.

Presently he is a member in Central Mental Health committee to guide and contribute towards improving the mental health of the country. He is also working with the  Department of Social Welfare of Delhi providing technical know how in establishment of half way home by the government.

He is on advisory board of various pharmacological companies and is closely associated with research and development of better medications to treat mental illness.
In addition, he has written and spoken on mental health issues and current affairs in leading print media like Times of India, Hindustan Times, Indian Express, Navbharat Times etc. and on television shows respectively. He is a recognized speaker at various mental health related conferences and clinical psychology conferences

His expertise and clinical experiences in psychiatric management include, but are not limited to:-

  • Psychiatric Outpatient and Inpatient treatment of mentally ill adults, children and adolescents, elderly men and women, homeless mentally ill and rehabilitation of mentally ill patients.
  • Pharmacological and Psychosocial management
  • Child and adolescent Psychiatry
  • Geriatric Psychiatry
  • De-addiction and rehabilitation.
  • Community outreach services.
  • Occupational Therapy
  • Forensic Psychiatry

He holds eminent positions of responsibility and contributes actively in Professional Bodies and NGO’s like:

  • President of Mental Research Society
  • Life Fellow, Indian Psychiatric Society
  • Life Member, Indian Medical Association
  • Life Member of Indian Association of Private Psychiatry

Life Member of Delhi Psychiatric Society

name: Dr. Poorva Gupta
bioHtml:
Dr. Poorva, a Consultant Psychiatrist with an MD in Psychiatry, brings years of clinical experience to her practice, providing comprehensive psychiatric care to children, adolescents, and adults. Her broad expertise encompasses diagnosing and treating a wide range of psychiatric disorders, including depression, anxiety, ocd, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, substance use disorders and personality disorders.

Dr. Poorva excels in psychopharmacology, using her extensive knowledge of psychiatric medications to optimize treatment outcomes. She carefully monitors her patients’ progress, making necessary adjustments to their medication regimens to achieve maximum therapeutic benefit while minimizing side effects. Her evidence-based approach ensures that her patients receive the most effective treatments available.

In addition to her MD, Dr. Poorva holds a certificate from NIMHANS in life skill training for adolescents. This additional qualification enhances her ability to support young patients, addressing their unique challenges and promoting their mental and emotional well-being.

Dr. Poorva works closely with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including psychologists, social workers, and primary care physicians, to provide integrated and holistic care for her patients. This collaborative approach ensures that all aspects of a patient’s mental health are addressed, promoting overall well-being.

Beyond the clinical setting, Dr. Poorva is dedicated to mental health advocacy. She works tirelessly to reduce the stigma associated with psychiatric disorders and promote mental health awareness in the community. She participates in public speaking engagements, workshops, and seminars, sharing her knowledge with both professional peers and the general public.

Dr. Poorva places a strong emphasis on continuous learning and professional development. She regularly attends conferences and workshops to stay updated on the latest advancements in psychiatry. This commitment to ongoing education ensures that she is always equipped with the most current knowledge and skills to benefit her patients.

Her approach to patient care is characterized by empathy and compassion. Dr. Poorva understands the profound impact that mental health issues can have on individuals and their families. She strives to create a supportive and non-judgmental environment for her patients, listening attentively and building strong therapeutic relationships based on trust and open communication.

In her practice, Dr. Poorva emphasizes a patient-centered approach. She involves her patients in the decision-making process regarding their treatment plans, empowering them to take an active role in their mental health care. This collaborative approach helps patients feel more in control of their mental health journey.

Dr. Poorva’s dedication to her patients, combined with her extensive clinical expertise and commitment to ongoing education, makes her a highly effective psychiatrist. Her holistic and compassionate approach to mental health care ensures that her patients receive the highest standard of care, enabling them to achieve optimal mental health and well-being.

name: Dr. Pooja Sharma
bioHtml:
Dr. Pooja Sharma is a dedicated, empathetic, and highly skilled psychiatrist with comprehensive training and experience in managing a wide spectrum of psychiatric disorders across age groups and care settings. She brings a patient-centric, inclusive, and evidence-based approach to mental health treatment, tailored to the unique needs of each individual.

Dr. Sharma completed her MBBS from the esteemed B.J. Government Medical College, Pune, followed by an MD in Psychiatry from the Central Institute of Psychiatry (CIP), Ranchi, one of India’s most prestigious and research-oriented mental health institutions.

She further honed her clinical skills during her tenure as Senior Resident at both CIP Ranchi and University College of Medical Sciences (UCMS) & Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital, Delhi, gaining hands-on experience in the management of acute and chronic psychiatric illnesses in inpatient, outpatient, and emergency care settings.

Her areas of clinical expertise include the diagnosis and treatment of Schizophrenia, Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD), Bipolar Affective Disorder, Depression, and Anxiety Disorders. She is also trained in managing psychiatric conditions in children and adolescents, as well as individuals with seizure disorders and neuropsychiatric conditions.

In addition to her core psychiatric training, Dr. Sharma holds specialized certifications in:

  • Motivational Interviewing
  • Mindfulness-Based Interventions
  • Neuromodulation Techniques, including non-invasive brain stimulation methods such as rTMS (Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation)

These additional skills allow her to integrate psychotherapeutic, biological, and neuromodulatory modalities to deliver comprehensive, patient-focused care.

Dr. Sharma is an LGBTQA+ affirmative therapist and provides a safe, respectful, and non-judgmental therapeutic space for individuals across diverse gender and sexual identities.

Her academic involvement includes presentations at national and international psychiatric conferences, conducting workshops on mental health awareness and clinical skills, and contributing to peer-reviewed publications and a book chapter. Her scholarly work reflects a commitment to staying at the forefront of psychiatric research and practice.

She is the recipient of the Leelabati Bholanath Award, recognising her excellence in clinical practice and her commitment to the field of psychiatry.

Above all, Dr. Sharma is known for her empathic approach, deep listening skills, and genuine concern for her patients’ well-being. She is a passionate mental health advocate, actively engaged in raising awareness, reducing stigma, and promoting early and effective interventions in mental health care.

With a holistic perspective and a deep belief in the potential for recovery and growth, Dr. Pooja Sharma empowers individuals and families to move toward emotional resilience and improved quality of life.

Dedicated to providing compassionate care, Mr Jain helps clients navigate life’s challenges, develop emotional strength, and live more fulfilling lives.

name: Dr. Ratnarakshit Ingole
bioHtml:
Dr. Ratnarakshit Ingole is a revered Senior Consultant Psychiatrist at Tulasi Healthcare, clocking 20 years of meaningful clinical experience in the field of psychiatry. He has been a core part of Tulasi Healthcare from the last 10 years, significantly contributing to its growth and reputation. He has played a part in building Tulasi Healthcare’s legacy as a leading psychiatric and rehabilitation center.

Dr. Ingole completed his M.B.B.S. from Indira Gandhi Government Medical College, Nagpur, and pursued his post-graduation (M.D.) in Psychiatry from the renowned Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh. After completing his specialization, he brushed up on his skill set for 3 years at the Institute of Human Behavior and Allied Sciences (IHBAS), New Delhi, where he handled and learnt extensively from complex and acute psychiatric cases.

At Tulasi Healthcare, Dr. Ingole has a pivotal role in providing holistic and personalized care to the clients. His expertise caters to a  variety of psychiatric conditions where the  primary focus is on adult psychiatry. He also has a strong interest in child psychiatry. Over the years, he has successfully worked with patients bearing conditions like:

  • Mood Disorders: Depression, dysthymia, and bipolar disorders.
  • Substance Use Disorders: Alcohol, drug, and behavioral addictions, with a focus on de-addiction and relapse prevention.
  • Psychosis: Schizophrenia and other severe mental illnesses.
  • Anxiety Disorders: Generalized anxiety, OCD, social anxiety, and panic disorders.
  • Dual Diagnosis: Co-occurring substance use and mental health conditions.
  • Relationship and Interpersonal Issues: Providing counseling and therapy for individuals facing challenges in their personal or professional lives.

Dr. Ingole focuses on an empathetic approach. His ability to administer tailored rehabilitation programs ensures his patients experience a meaningful recovery. His work extends beyond clinical boundaries, as he actively engages with families and caregivers to create a supportive environment for healing and rehabilitation.

He has dedicated his career to the advancement of mental health.  With his passion about reducing stigma, he has spread awareness about psychiatric disorders through workshops, community outreach, and patient education. He empowers individuals and communities to prioritize mental wellness.

Dr. Ingole’s patients and colleagues recognize him for his commitment, compassionate nature, and extensive knowledge in psychiatry. His 10-year association with Tulasi Healthcare is a testament to his dedication to improving lives and contributing to the field of mental health.

name: Dr. Sameer Guliani
bioHtml:
Dr. Sameer Guliani is a Consultant Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist at Tulasi Healthcare, Gurgaon. With over a decade of specialised global experience, he offers expert care in managing complex psychological, behavioural, and neurodevelopmental conditions in children and young adults.

He completed MBBS and MD Psychiatry from Himalayan Institute of Medical Sciences, Dehradun and Dr. DY Patil University, Pune respectively. He ranked first in both MBBS and MD university examinations, and was awarded the Gold medal for his postgraduate training. Dr Guliani was the winner of National Torrent Young Scholar Award in Psychiatry (2014).

Dr. Guliani possesses comprehensive professional experience across premier healthcare institutions in both India and the United Kingdom. He began his consultant career at Fortis Healthcare, New Delhi, serving from 2015 to 2017, before moving to the UK to pursue further training. There, he initially completed the MTI Psychiatry Fellowship Maudsley the Cardiff and Vale NHS Trust and earned his membership status (MRCPsych) through the Royal College of Psychiatrists, London.

Dr. Guliani further pursued advanced specialisation in the UK, obtaining his Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry from the prestigious South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust.

Dr Guliani has worked in intensive inpatient ward settings and comprehensive outpatient clinics, enabling him to manage a broad spectrum of acute and chronic presentations.

He has worked within premier multi-disciplinary teams, providing targeted, evidence-based interventions for complex neurodevelopmental and psychiatric conditions. His clinical expertise includes the evaluation and management of Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD), Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD), and Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD).Additionally, he possesses vast experience in crisis intervention, stabilising acute mental health emergencies and managing severe mood disorders and psychosis.

Dr Guliani is a Life Member of the Indian Psychiatric Society and the Indian Association for Child and Adolescent Mental Health.

name: Dr. Suravi Das
bioHtml:
Dr. Suravi Das is a Consultant Psychiatrist who completed her MD in Psychiatry, graduating as the University Topper in Psychiatry, and her internship at Smt. NHL Municipal Medical College, Ahmedabad.

Before specializing in Psychiatry, Dr. Das worked as a Medical Officer in Respiratory Medicine and Cardiology, which provided her with a strong foundation in general medicine and a deeper appreciation of the connection between physical and emotional well-being.

Her academic work includes a randomized controlled trial comparing vortioxetine and escitalopram in the management of depression. She has presented papers and posters at national conferences, including ANCIPS and CIPCON, reflecting her continued commitment to evidence-based psychiatric practice and research. She is also a Life Member of the Indian Psychiatric Society (IPS).

Dr. Das’s clinical interests include mood disorders, anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), addiction psychiatry, women’s mental health, and queer-affirmative mental healthcare. She is dedicated to providing compassionate, inclusive, and evidence-based care tailored to the unique needs and experiences of each individual.

Outside of her clinical work, Dr. Das enjoys playing basketball and lawn tennis. Her involvement in sports has given her a personal appreciation of the discipline, resilience, setbacks, and performance pressures that often accompany athletic pursuits. This perspective helps her connect with individuals navigating the mental and emotional demands of sport, performance, and achievement.

She believes that every individual’s journey is unique. Combining scientific evidence with a genuine interest in each person’s story, she strives to help individuals better understand their experiences and navigate life’s challenges with greater clarity and confidence.

Understanding cultural adjustment complexities, she offers support to individuals adapting to new environments. Her compassionate approach extends to treating eating disorders and providing grief and loss counseling, guiding clients through the healing process.

bioHtml:
Dr. Pranita Gaur is a Senior Consultant Psychologist at Tulsi Healthcare with over 40 years of experience in clinical psychology, counseling, teaching, and research. Based in Gurugram, Haryana, she has dedicated her career to promoting mental well-being, supporting students and families, and advancing the field of psychology through both clinical practice and academia.

She completed her M.Phil. and Ph.D. in Psychology from the University of Delhi, building a strong foundation in evidence-based psychological assessment, psychotherapy, and counseling.

Over the course of her career, Dr. Gaur has worked with individuals across all age groups, helping them overcome a wide range of emotional and psychological challenges. Her areas of expertise include:

  • – Student mental health and academic stress
  • – Child and family counseling
  • – Individual psychotherapy
  • – Relationship and interpersonal issues
  • – Emotional well-being and personal growth

Dr. Gaur is known for her warm, compassionate, and holistic approach to mental healthcare. She believes in understanding each person’s unique experiences and tailoring treatment to their individual needs.

Alongside her clinical practice, Dr. Gaur has had a distinguished academic career. She served as a Professor of Psychology at Mata Sundari College, University of Delhi, where she taught undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral students, mentoring many aspiring psychologists throughout her tenure.

She has also worked as an Honorary Consultant Psychologist at Amar Jyoti Rehabilitation & Research Centre and as a Consultant Psychologist at Delhi Psychiatric Centre and Shanti Mukand Hospital, providing psychological assessment, counseling, and therapy to people from diverse backgrounds.

As a researcher and mentor, Dr. Gaur has led NCERT-sponsored research projects on values and conflict resolution and Delhi University Innovation Project exploring happiness among young adults. She has published 15 research papers in national and international peer-reviewed journals and contributed 3 book chapters on mental health and applied psychology.

Respected by both her clients and peers, Dr. Gaur is recognized for her empathy, professionalism, and decades of expertise. Her lifelong commitment to mental health continues to inspire individuals, strengthen families, reduce stigma around psychological care, and promote lasting emotional well-being.

name: Ms. Hardika
bioHtml:
Hardika is an RCI-registered Clinical Psychologist with an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology. She is trained in comprehensive psychological assessment and provides evidence-based psychological interventions and psychotherapy to adolescents and adults experiencing a wide range of emotional, behavioural, and psychological concerns, including anxiety, depression, OCD, personality-related concerns, substance use disorders, stress, and life transitions.

She has experience in psychological assessment, psychotherapy, psychoeducation, relapse prevention, and family-caregiver interventions, recognising the important role families play in supporting recovery and long-term well-being. Believing that every individual is unique, she follows an eclectic, evidence-based approach, thoughtfully tailoring therapy to each person’s needs, strengths, values, and goals. Rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all model, she integrates interventions from CBT, DBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing (MI), mindfulness-based interventions, relapse prevention, supportive and group interventions along other evidence-based approaches to provide person centred care.

Hardika believes that meaningful change is best achieved through a collaborative partnership between the individual, their family, and the therapist. She works from a holistic, person-centred perspective, helping individuals not only reduce psychological distress but also build resilience, strengthen relationships, achieve greater independence, and enhance their overall well-being. She believes that every individual possesses the capacity for growth and resilience, and that with the right support, guidance, and a trusting therapeutic relationship, meaningful change is always possible.

She views therapy as a collaborative journey, working alongside individuals and their families to foster insight, build on existing strengths, develop effective coping strategies, and promote long-term recovery, resilience, and independence.

Her goal is to create a warm, safe, and non-judgmental therapeutic space where individuals feel genuinely heard, respected, and empowered to make meaningful and lasting changes in their lives.

Apoorva Khanna is an RCI-Licensed Rehabilitation Psychologist and Child and Adolescent Psychotherapist dedicated to supporting young people and families through life’s challenges. She holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology (PGDRP), a Post Graduate Diploma in Child and Adolescent Counselling (PGDCAC), and an M.A. in Clinical Psychology from Amity University.

Her clinical experience spans SPYM, NAB Delhi, Brahmashakti Special School, Moolchand Medcity Hospital, Lyfsmile, and The Therapy Park, giving her a well-rounded foundation for working closely with children, adolescents, and their families to build resilience, emotional awareness, and healthy coping skills.

Her clinical insights have been shared through four published research papers and conference presentations, including at NACIACP. She is a member of several professional bodies, including the APA, ANZMH, ISSUP, IACP, and RCI.

name: Ms. Angshruta Mahanta
bioHtml:
Angshruta Mahanta is a Psychiatric Social Worker with an MPhil in Psychiatric Social Work from NIMHANS, Bengaluru, and a Master’s in Social Work (Counselling) from Tata institute of Social Sciences. She is dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based mental health care while helping individuals and families navigate emotional, psychological, and social challenges.

She works with children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families experiencing a wide range of mental health concerns, including depression, anxiety, psychosis, substance use disorders, personality disorders, and relationship difficulties. Her approach is collaborative, empathetic, and tailored to the unique needs of each individual.

Her areas of work include individual counselling, family interventions, couple therapy, psychoeducation, relapse prevention, motivational enhancement, social skills training, life skills development, and caregiver support. 

Angshruta integrates evidence-based therapeutic approaches such as Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), and family-focused interventions to promote recovery, resilience, and improved quality of life.

She believes that effective mental health care extends beyond symptom management and focuses on empowering individuals, strengthening family support systems, and fostering long-term emotional well-being. Her goal is to provide a safe, respectful, and non-judgmental space where people feel heard, supported, and equipped to work towards meaningful change.

name: Dr. Samridhi Sandooja
bioHtml:
Dr. Samridhi Sandooja is a dedicated and compassionate Psychiatrist with 11+ years of experience in the field of mental health. She is committed to improving the quality of life of individuals experiencing mental, behavioural and emotional concerns through personalised, evidence-based and holistic care.

She completed her MD in Psychiatry from AIIMS, New Delhi, and holds a Certificate in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry from the Indian Association of Child and Adolescent Mental Health (IACAM).

Dr. Samridhi has gained diverse clinical experience across reputed mental health settings, including the Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences (IHBAS). She has also served as Clinical Head at mPOWER, Mumbai(unit of Aditya Birla Education Trust), where she was involved in comprehensive mental healthcare and multidisciplinary clinical practice.

Her areas of clinical interest include the assessment and management of a broad range of psychiatric, behavioural and emotional concerns across different stages of life. She believes that every individual is unique, and that understanding a person’s concerns, circumstances and individual needs is fundamental to providing effective and meaningful care.

Dr. Samridhi follows a holistic and patient-centred approach, integrating biological, psychological and social aspects of mental health. She also values collaboration with families and multidisciplinary healthcare teams to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care.

Her approach is grounded in empathy, clinical expertise and the belief that mental healthcare should not only address symptoms, but also help individuals achieve better functioning, resilience and overall quality of life.

name: Dr. (Col.) Pavan Kumar Pardal
bioHtml:
Dr. Colonel Pavan Kumar Pardal has been in psychiatry for about four decades – as a clinician, teacher, researcher and administrator. He served as Professor and Head of Psychiatry at SRMS, Bareilly, for nearly 19 years, contributing significantly to the department’s establishment and development.

His journey commenced in 1979, when he joined the Army Medical Corps after pursuing his MBBS at MLN Medical College, Allahabad. He earned his MD in Psychiatry from the Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC), Pune, in 1987. Over the years in uniform, he went on to lead some of the armed forces, most important psychiatric centres – experience that shaped both his clinical judgement and his approach to mentorship.

Along the way, he built deep, hands-on experience in OCD and addiction psychiatry, areas he’s continued to treat and teach with particular focus throughout his career.

Teaching has been just a central to his career is treating patients. As a post graduate teacher and examiner, he guided countless MD and DNB psychiatry students, while also shaping academic curriculum along the way. His research contributions of around 30 publications in national and international journals reflect a career spent staying curious and engaged with the field, not just practising within it.

He is a life fellow of the Indian Psychiatric Society and a life member of the Delhi Psychiatric Society – recognitions that speak to a career built on both depth of experience and consistent contribution to the profession.

name: Dr. Rini Maurya
bioHtml:
Dr. Rini Maurya is a dedicated and compassionate Consultant Psychiatrist with extensive clinical experience across premier medical institutions, including the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Rajkot, and NIMHANS. She completed her MD in Psychiatry from Sri Siddhartha Medical College, Tumakuru, where she graduated at the top of her batch.  

Dr. Maurya brings an empathetic, evidence-based, and holistic approach to psychiatric care, combining clinical pharmacotherapy with supportive psychological interventions. With a robust background in consultation-liaison psychiatry, mood disorders, and community mental health, geriatric and child and adolescent psychiatry. She specializes in designing individualized treatment regimens tailored to both acute psychiatric stabilization and long-term psychosocial rehabilitation. Active in biomedical research, she has presented extensively at national psychiatric conferences and published peer-reviewed studies focused on psychiatric co-morbidities and psycho-dermatology.
